words.example: At the board round we decide who can go home today.
words.exampleZh: 看板交班时我们决定今天谁可以回家。

words.example: The bed meeting wants discharge predictions, not just the census.
words.exampleZh: 床位会要的是预计出院情况，不只是在院人数。

words.example: The ops meeting this week will focus on the registration queue.
words.exampleZh: 这周的运营会重点看挂号排队。

words.example: The quality meeting asked each ward for one lesson learned.
words.exampleZh: 质量会要求每个病区交一条经验教训。

words.example: Yesterday's safety huddle covered a missing patient label.
words.exampleZh: 昨天的安全短会谈了一例患者标签缺失。

words.example: The fingerprint reader on the pharmacy cabinet rejects wet fingers.
words.exampleZh: 药房柜子上的指纹读取器不认湿的手指。

words.example: Face ID at the drug room fails when the nurse wears a surgical cap.
words.exampleZh: 护士戴着手术帽时，药品间的人脸识别会失败。

words.example: Single sign-on failed, so the ward typed passwords into four separate systems.
words.exampleZh: 单点登录失败之后，病区只好在四个系统里分别输入密码。

words.example: The password vault has no entry yet for the new lab analyzer.
words.exampleZh: 密码保险箱里还没有这台新检验分析仪的条目。

words.example: The privileged account for database changes was used at two in the morning.
words.exampleZh: 用来改数据库的特权账号在凌晨两点被使用了。
